4most expands actuarial offering with chief actuary capability

summary: 4most is A trusted and specialist analytics consultancy that champions its people above all else. That’s 4most | B Corp Certified, founded in 2011. Type: private company. About 273 employees (LinkedIn page). Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 2 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about growth or hiring.

insights.one_liner: A London-based credit-risk and actuarial consultancy for banks and insurers, partly staff-owned, hiring experienced risk people in Amsterdam.

culture.text: Over 250 credit risk and actuarial consultants, and staff own a significant share of the business.
Staff mostly studied maths, economics, statistics, actuarial science or physics.
It has been a certified B Corp since March 2025.

open.text: Both current Amsterdam roles mention visas and don't require Dutch.
It is not listed as an IND recognised sponsor, so check how it handles visas.

growth.text: It says it has ambitious plans to keep growing.
It expanded its actuarial offering with a chief actuary service.

worth_knowing.text: Current Amsterdam openings are mid and senior level, not graduate roles.
